verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a developer SDK for AI browser automation. It does not hold user data or offer an in-product analytics surface, so "AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product" is a category error for this product type. Its AI extract() and observe() primitives pull structured data from webpages and propose page actions. They serve automation workflows and are not insights drawn from the user's own data, so they do not make this axis applicable.
